title: I Forwarded the Board-Game Cafe Timer After They Camped the Table

parts.text: I reserved table four at 2:02 p.m. and the same four still had Catan boxed like a fort. The timer the manager taped said: TWO HOURS UNLESS THE WAITLIST IS EMPTY. I was twenty-seven, Saturday regular, holding a ticket that said 2:00. The campers said, "We're mid-game. That's sacred." I pointed at the tape. Their leader laughed. "Sacred beats a kitchen timer." I photographed the boxes, the timer, and my ticket. Then I forwarded the cafe's own SMS waitlist ping to the manager with the photo. At 2:07 the manager asked why table four was on an overtime camp report.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The manager can see Catan boxed past two hours with a waitlist ping attached.

social.video_title: They camped Catan past the two-hour timer — Part 1/2
social.description: Saturday ticket, a Catan fort, and a taped timer. I forwarded the ping. Would you have waited in the doorway?

parts.text: They called it a finale until the waitlist asked for the table. I printed the report, the timer, and the photo. Table four reset. They boxed in a huff and told Reddit the timer was always about optics. Optics is a word campers use when an SMS exists. Cafe policy now has a second line: MID-GAME IS NOT A LEASE. I play on time. They reserve like adults. The sand timer actually finishes.

social.video_title: Mid-game is not a table lease — Part 2/2
social.description: Camp report, a reset, and a second line on the tape. Was sacred ever two extra hours?
